gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed World Health Organization Grade IV malignant glioma (glioblastoma or gliosarcoma).

candidate_evidence.quote: Intravenously administered type of gene therapy that works by blocking the process of blood-vessel creation.
Participants evidencing disease progression may initiate bevacizumab at a pre-determined dose as needed for supportive care

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: First or second progression of glioblastoma/gliosarcoma (according to RANO criteria) following standard of care treatment upon initial diagnosis with radiation.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Tumor infiltrating T cell (TIL) density is defined as the number of T lymphocytes per nucleated cell, and calculated by detailed sequencing of recombined T cell receptor sequences obtained from the tumor specimen gDNA.

role_evidence.quote: Intravenously administered type of gene therapy that works by blocking the process of blood-vessel creation.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: VB-111 works by targeting and damaging the blood vessels that grow and nourish cancerous tumors leading to tumor starvation.

role_evidence.quote: Participants evidencing disease progression may initiate bevacizumab at a pre-determined dose as needed for supportive care

agents.drug_class_hint: anti-VEGF monoclonal antibody; established GBM therapy

biomarkers.biomarker_other: tumour-infiltrating T cell density / TCR clonality by T-cell receptor sequencing of tumour gDNA

source_quote.quote: Tumor infiltrating T cell (TIL) density is defined as the number of T lymphocytes per nucleated cell, and calculated by detailed sequencing of recombined T cell receptor sequences obtained from the tumor specimen gDNA.

coder_notes: Only investigational agent is VB-111 (ofranergene obadenovec), described as gene therapy -> excluded_intervention_type; S6 fails. Bevacizumab may be started at progression 'as needed for supportive care' -> supportive (an established GBM therapy, but not the question). Tumour TIL-density PD endpoint exists (and per outcome text was never performed) but relates to the excluded gene therapy, not a candidate, so target_engagement_planned coded no. Arm 'After Surgery Standard of Care' is labelled EXPERIMENTAL but serves as the placebo/standard-of-care control -> control_arm_from_other_arms yes. 'Grade IV malignant glioma (glioblastoma or gliosarcoma)' without IDH -> historical.
